title: Pan-Seared Cod with Umami Sauce
description: A simple and flavorful Portuguese-inspired dish that pairs perfectly with a side of rice or vegetables. The umami sauce adds a rich and savory flavor to the delicate cod.

ingredients.name: unique sea salt
ingredients.notes: use a flaky sea salt for best flavor

ingredients.name: portuguese olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: skillet
ingredients.notes: use a stainless steel or cast iron skillet for best results

instructions: Season the cod fillets with unique sea salt and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Heat the portuguese olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the cod fillets to the skillet and sear for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
While the cod is cooking, heat the umami sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
Serve the cod with the umami sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
